_about: Per-comp overrides by base name (before ' — '). max_tier caps the tier (data tiers can't see emblem/augment/artifact dependence); needs is shown on the comp card; must adds must-have items per carry (an asterisk in the item builds).

Veigar Reroll.needs: Consuming Flora emblem; lots of contested 1–2 costs

Solar Yunara.needs: emblems + item augments; Yunara lacks carry DPS without them

Tristana Rengar Reroll.needs: an emblem and an early Rengar

Elderwood Veigar.note: Your read: weak early, and Ornn is a poor tank, so it gets smashed unless you have its pieces (artifacts, emblems or Consuming Flora).

Kha'Zix Reroll.note: Key comp this meta: Kha'Zix reaches the backline and kills the one carry that 1-cost 2★ rageblade boards depend on. Only works if you find Kha'Zix.

Azir Rammus Reroll.note: Your read: Guinsoo's is a must-have on Azir (bunnymuffins only marks Gunblade).
